run_pre_check: run pre_check to download and verify the inswapper_128.onnx face swapper model
run_pre_start: run pre_start to validate model files exist and load the face swapper successfully
swap_face_source_target: swap a source face onto a target face within a frame using the loaded inswapper model
process_frames_video: process a list of video frame paths and write swapped results back to each frame path
process_image_swap: process a single target image by swapping a source face and saving the output image
create_face_mask: create a feathered face mask covering the whole face area based on 106-point landmarks
apply_color_transfer: apply LAB color transfer from a source image to a target image for color matching
create_lower_mouth_mask: create a lower mouth mask from face landmarks for preserving original mouth area during face swap
